title: The best Database for AI-Built Apps
description: Talk about databases and VPSs and which ones, why? Yeah, so, you know, I think for most applications, like a Postgres application, will probably be your best bet. Supabase and Neon are the two providers that can allow you to host your database and they've just become kind of the default for building applications, building products. But Postgres, if you're really doing something simple, SQLite is a database that's in a file. And you can do it locally and it's really quick and dirty. You can get up and going and you don't need to think about hosting the database. Or if you're really just building a very simple application, SQLite can go a long way.
